question: Among players under 180 cm tall who have at least one rating recorded between 2013-07-01 and 2016-06-30, what percentage have an average overall rating above 75? Additionally, return the total count of such short players and the count of those exceeding the rating threshold.

arguments.sql:
WITH eligible_players AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_121 AS player_id
    FROM Player p
    WHERE p.XCL_126 < 180
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Player_Attributes pa
          WHERE pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
            AND pa.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2013-07-01' AND '2016-06-30'
      )
),
player_avg_ratings AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_121 AS player_id,
        AVG(pa.XCL_132) AS avg_rating
    FROM Player p
    INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
    WHERE p.XCL_126 < 180
      AND pa.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2013-07-01' AND '2016-06-30'
    GROUP BY p.XCL_121
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN par.avg_rating > 75 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(par.player_id) AS percentage_above_75,
    COUNT(par.player_id) AS total_short_players,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN par.avg_rating > 75 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS count_above_threshold
FROM player_avg_ratings par

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH eligible_players AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_121 AS player_id
    FROM Player p
    WHERE p.XCL_126 < 180
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Player_Attributes pa
          WHERE pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
            AND pa.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2013-07-01' AND '2016-06-30'
      )
),
player_avg_ratings AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_121 AS player_id,
        AVG(pa.XCL_132) AS avg_rating
    FROM Player p
    INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
    WHERE p.XCL_126 < 180
      AND pa.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2013-07-01' AND '2016-06-30'
    GROUP BY p.XCL_121
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN par.avg_rating > 75 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(par.player_id) AS percentage_above_75,
    COUNT(par.player_id) AS total_short_players,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN par.avg_rating > 75 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS count_above_threshold
FROM player_avg_ratings par

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base_players AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_121 AS player_id,
        AVG(pa.XCL_132) AS avg_rating
    FROM Player p
    INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
    WHERE p.XCL_126 < 180
      AND pa.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2013-07-01' AND '2016-06-30'
    GROUP BY p.XCL_121
),
stats AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_short_players,
        SUM(CASE WHEN avg_rating > 75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_above_threshold
    FROM base_players
)
SELECT 
    (count_above_threshold * 100.0 / total_short_players) AS percentage_above_75,
    total_short_players,
    count_above_threshold
FROM stats

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH ShortPlayersWithRatings AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_121 AS player_id,
        pa.XCL_132 AS overall_rating,
        pa.XCL_131 AS rating_date
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
    WHERE p.XCL_126 < 180
      AND pa.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2013-07-01' AND '2016-06-30'
),
PlayerAvgRatings AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_rating
    FROM ShortPlayersWithRatings
    GROUP BY player_id
),
FinalStats AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_short_players,
        SUM(CASE WHEN avg_rating > 75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_above_75
    FROM PlayerAvgRatings
)
SELECT 
    (COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlayerAvgRatings)) AS percentage_above_75,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlayerAvgRatings) AS total_short_players,
    (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN avg_rating > 75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM PlayerAvgRatings) AS count_above_75
FROM PlayerAvgRatings
